# Omar Olivares
> Personal site of Omar Olivares Urrutia — software engineer specializing in AI/ML, with interests in interpretability, alignment, and agentic systems.

Contact: omar@olivares.cl · https://x.com/omarnomad · https://github.com/ofou · https://www.linkedin.com/in/ofou/

## Pages
- [Home](https://olivares.cl/): Brief bio and what Omar works on
- [Blog](https://olivares.cl/blog/): Technical writing on AI, ML, and hacking
- [Projects](https://olivares.cl/projects/): Selected builds and experiments
- [CV](https://olivares.cl/cv/): Résumé
- [Contact](https://olivares.cl/contact/): How to reach Omar

## Blog
- [Things you should be reading about AI in 2025](https://olivares.cl/blog/2025/01/01/things-you-should-be-reading-about-ai-in-2025/): Reading list across AI, ML, and neuroscience textbooks and codebases
- [Introduction to Tinygrad](https://olivares.cl/blog/2025/06/10/introduction-to-tinygrad/): Lazy tensors, UOps, realization, autodiff, and the rewrite engine
- [Vibe hacking Ableton's Push 3](https://olivares.cl/blog/2026/01/12/vibe-hacking-ableton-s-push-3/): Reverse-engineering Push 3 MIDI, USB, and display without official docs

## Projects
- [Lab](https://olivares.cl/projects/lab/): Interactive canvas explainables for posts (wave, Fourier, etc.)
- [WebGrid Eval](https://olivares.cl/projects/webgrid-eval/): Multimodal LLM harness for Neuralink's WebGrid cursor task
- [TexTube](https://olivares.cl/projects/textube/): YouTube transcripts as a ChatGPT plugin / API
- [Graham Essays](https://olivares.cl/projects/graham/): Paul Graham essays as EPUB and Markdown, updated daily
